You're very welcome, Ethan! I'm glad I could help you upgrade your running shoes. Your order #W9911714 is all set with the black synthetic shoes, and it will continue processing for shipment.

Have a wonderful day, and enjoy your upgraded gear when it arrives! Take care! 😊

祝您今天愉快，收到升级装备时尽情享受！多保重！😊
